newsitem.title: USA: San Francisco Mayor seeks citywide audit - spokesman.
newsitem.headline: San Francisco Mayor seeks citywide audit - spokesman.

text.p: San Francisco Mayor Willie Brown plans to hire a team of outside auditors to review every city department, a spokesman said on Wednesday.

"(Brown) would like to bring in a team headed by a respected independent person who is no longer connected to the city, somebody who could perform an all-around audit of city departments," Brown spokesman P.J. Johnston said.
"The when and the who, those are the things that need to be worked out," the spokesman said.
Brown's call for a citywide audit followed reports that a low-level city accountant allegedly stole more than $100,000 a year for at least seven years from a petty cash fund.
